title: Interactive Failure Explorer & Trace-Handoff Dashboard
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an interactive failure exploration surface that links aggregated error/latency metrics to raw traces and model-runtime annotations. This work is intended to reduce MTTI for customer-facing failures by making it trivial to pivot from a spike in error-rate or tail latency to the underlying traces, and to surface model-specific failure classes (timeo ut, overload, KV cache evictions, model nan/abort, HTTP/gRPC codes). The dashboard will be both an operational view for on-call and an investigative tool for reliability and SRE. Deliverables: new dashboard in Grafana/LookerStudio, tracing hook changes to attach model runtime context to spans, log/metric pipeline enrichment to include failure_class labels, and alert rule tweaks to use the enriched dimensions.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard has a top-level failure-explorer (heatmap + sortable table) that can filter by service, route, model, and time window
Each error row links to a pre-filtered trace search that shows representative spans and a timeline with model-runtime annotations
Tracing hooks attach: model_id, model_version, kv_cache_hit_rate, current_batch_size, decoder_steps, and failure_class to relevant spans
Failure taxonomy implemented in pipeline: timeout | overload | model_error | invalid_input | transport_error (HTTP/gRPC codes) | downstream_dependency
Log/metrics pipeline includes failure_class label and preserves it in aggregated metrics exported to metrics backend
On-call runbook includes playbook entries and the dashboard is useful for at least two simulated incident scenarios in the runbook test
tasks: Add tracing hook in runtime: runtime/trace/hooks.cpp - attach model_id, batch_size, kv_cache_evictions (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1127)
Schema change for pipeline tags: add 'failure_class' and 'model_runtime_context' to structured logs (Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Failure+Taxonomy+Spec)
Metric enrichment: modify Fluentd/Vector pipeline to forward failure_class to metrics ingest (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/301)
Grafana dashboard: create 'Interactive Failure Explorer' with heatmap, density plots, and trace links (Design Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/obs-IE/Failure-Explorer)
Sampling policy: implement adaptive trace sampling for error and tail-latency traces (config change in observability-config repo)
Alerting: update alert rules to fire on failure_class-specific thresholds and add runbook links
QA: create two incident replay scenarios (timeout storm, overload cascade) and verify dashboard surfacing and trace handoff
Docs: update internal troubleshooting guide and add 'How to use Failure Explorer' quickstart
